Thermodynamical Second-Order Hydrodynamic Coefficients
M. L. G. Alford;S. Bhattacharya;A. Vuorinen
Thermodynamically second-order hydrodynamic transport coefficients.

the second order thermodynamical transport coefficients can be expressed in terms of Kubo formulae, that these formulae involve the retarded correlation functions of the stress tensor, that they can be computed perturbatively at leading order in a theory that contains a general matter content, and that they can be evaluated on the lattice by using the method of spectral functions.

we derive Kubo formulas for the second-order thermodynamic transport coefficients of a general matter content, and we compute them at leading order in a gauge theory, and we show how to approach their lattice evaluation.
